name: Wakatsuki Kagami
source:
Kagami is [url=https://vndb.org/c3565]Yuki[/url]'s childhood friend that acts as a stereotypical tsundere. She frequently argues with [url=https://vndb.org/c3560]Takuji[/url] in school as well and is fiercely protective of her younger twin sister [url=https://vndb.org/c3566]Tsukasa[/url].
